Caring Village.features: One shared app for a family's care: calendar, to-dos, medication lists, care plan, journal, group messages, document storage, and an AI helper called Julia.
Caring Village.differentiation: Claims to be one 'command center' that replaces scattered texts and spreadsheets, built by former caregivers, with a 24/7 AI assistant.
Caring Village.business_model: Freemium subscription. A free plan with ads, plus paid Circle and Village plans. It also sells to businesses for their patients or clients, and offers gift subscriptions. No funding figure found.
Caring Village.who_pays_cost: The caregiver who creates the 'village' pays. Everyone invited joins free. Free: 2 members. Circle: $14.99 a month (5 members). Village: $24.99 a month (50 members on the pricing page, 25 in the FAQ). 17% off yearly.

CaringBridge.features: A private web page or app journal for health updates, with comments, a help calendar for meals and rides, and links to GoFundMe and Meal Train.
CaringBridge.differentiation: Claims to be the established nonprofit (since 1997) built only for health journeys: private, ad-free, and never selling personal data.
CaringBridge.business_model: A free, donation-funded nonprofit: about $10.6M revenue in FY2025, 97% from contributions. It asks users for gifts, and its privacy policy also lists sharing data for targeted ads.
CaringBridge.who_pays_cost: A patient or family caregiver creates the page, and friends and family read it. It's free for everyone. Donors fund it, often the same families (6).

Medisafe.features: Medication reminders and refill alerts, drug-interaction warnings, one account for several family members' meds, and a 'Medfriend' who is alerted to missed doses.
Medisafe.differentiation: Claims to be the number-one medication reminder, ranked first by pharmacists, with complicated dosing and security certifications.
Medisafe.business_model: Free app with a paid subscription (price not shown, the pricing pages saved as 404s). It also sells a platform to drug makers and providers and may share de-identified data commercially. Raised a $30M Series C in 2021.
Medisafe.who_pays_cost: Patients and family members use it; drug companies and providers are business customers. Free app; Premium on the App Store costs $2.99 to $9.99 a month or $27.99 to $39.99 a year (several price points listed). Source: competitors-4/medisafe/firecrawl_appstore_medisafe.txt

Everplans.features: A secure online vault for documents, IDs, accounts and wishes, with guided checklists and 'deputies' who get access to chosen sections.
Everplans.differentiation: Claims to organize all of a person's life details and tell them what to do next, using a smart planning system.
Everplans.business_model: Freemium: free (3 items) or Premium at $99.99 a year, plus deals through financial advisors and partners. Owned by Precoa since October 2024.
Everplans.who_pays_cost: People organizing their own affairs pay for Premium themselves, or get it through an advisor (who pays then isn't stated). $99.99 a year.

Group texts.features: Family group chats, group texts and WhatsApp groups used to share news and ask for help.
Group texts.differentiation: Not a company. Everyone already has it, it's free, and there's nothing to install.
Group texts.who_pays_cost: The main family caregiver, relatives, and also paid care staff and agencies (6). Free.

Paper notebook and visit log.features: Notebooks, binders, whiteboards, wall calendars and home visit logs for meds, appointments, papers and notes.
Paper notebook and visit log.differentiation: Not a company. It needs no phone, and anyone, including nurses and the parent, can write in it.
Paper notebook and visit log.business_model: Not a company. Cheap to start, but store-bought planners can disappoint (4).
Paper notebook and visit log.who_pays_cost: The main caregiver, paid aides and the person being cared for. Nearly free.
